## Problem to solve

A clear and concise description of the problem you are trying to solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

What other approaches have you considered? Why did you not choose them?

## Use case

Describe a concrete use case where this feature would be valuable.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
